assumes: inputs purely differential (vd = Vinp - Vinn); tail node a virtual ground; first-stage mirror pole-zero doublet neglected; two poles and one RHP zero (no nulling resistor)
source: textbook two-stage Miller model, Allen & Holberg, CMOS Analog Circuit Design, 3rd ed., sec. 6.2; written for this flow as a stand-in for the upstream symbolic stage (not produced upstream)
naming: level-0 symbols as in the upstream 5t-ota file: C1_<dev> gate-bulk, C2 gate-source, C3 gate-drain, C4 drain-bulk, C5 source-bulk, G1 gm, R1 1/gds; C_<passive> the value of a netlist capacitor
performance_note: terms each in those before it; pm_deg from the dominant pole, the second pole and the RHP zero

terms.C1n: C2_XNormalTransistorNmos3 + C1_XNormalTransistorNmos3 + C4_XNormalTransistorPmos6 + C4_XNormalTransistorNmos4 + C3_XNormalTransistorNmos4 + C3_XNormalTransistorPmos6

v(out) per vd.form: H(s) = Gm(s)*(gm2 - s*Cc)*R1o*R2o / (1 + s*(R1o*(C1n + Cc) + R2o*(C2n + Cc) + gm2*R1o*R2o*Cc) + s**2*R1o*R2o*(C1n*C2n + Cc*(C1n + C2n))), Gm(s) = gm1*(1 + s*tau_z)/(1 + s*tau_m)
poles_rad_s: the two roots of the quadratic denominator

terms.C1n: C2_XNormalTransistorNmos3 + C1_XNormalTransistorNmos3 + C4_XNormalTransistorPmos6 + C4_XNormalTransistorNmos4 + C3_XNormalTransistorNmos4 + C3_XNormalTransistorPmos6

patch.status: PREDICTED (patched, post hoc): textbook terms added by this repository after seeing this circuit's PM gap (G1.5, 17 deg); derived input, regenerated by src/s1/symbolic_patch_miller.py from the S1 outputs
patch.reason: the original 'assumes' neglects the first-stage mirror pole-zero doublet; on this design the mirror pole sits next to the unity-gain frequency
changes: Gm(s) = gm1/2*(1 + 1/(1 + s*tau_m)): the half of the signal from XNormalTransistorPmos7 passes through the mirror node FirstStageYout1; tau_m = C_m/g_m, g_m = gm + gds of XDiodeTransistorNmos1 + gds of XNormalTransistorPmos7
C_m: the S1 linear model's capacitance at FirstStageYout1 (diagonal of C), written as C4_XDiodeTransistorNmos1 + 1.11243e-12 F so that the node's sensitivity can be taken symbolically
wu: magnitude condition with the doublet solved exactly (quadratic in w^2) from the original wu0
pm_deg: adds atan(wu*tau_m) - atan(wu*tau_z) to the original phase lag
assumptions: matched input pair: the mirrored half uses the file's gm1 (G1 of XNormalTransistorPmos6); XNormalTransistorPmos7's gm differs by the amount recorded in symbolic_patch_check.json
matched mirror: XNormalTransistorNmos4 copies XDiodeTransistorNmos1's current 1:1, so Gm(0) = gm1 as in the original
the mirror node's other nodes are AC ground for its time constant (C from the diagonal of C)
references: P. E. Allen, D. R. Holberg, CMOS Analog Circuit Design, 3rd ed., sec. 6.2: two-stage op amp, the mirror pole of the first stage with a left-half-plane zero at twice its frequency
B. Razavi, Design of Analog CMOS Integrated Circuits, 2nd ed., ch. 5/10: five-transistor OTA, mirror pole gm3/C_mirror with a zero at twice its frequency
W. Sansen, Analog Design Essentials, ch. 5 (OTA with current-mirror load: pole-zero doublet)
